old: Designating geographic regions in the Carpathian Basin requires specific locative suffixes: *Erdélyben* (-ban/-ben, inessive), *a Vajdaságban* (-ban/-ben), but *a Felvidéken* (-on/-en/-ön, superessive), *Kárpátalján* (-on/-en/-ön), and *az Őrvidéken / Burgenlandban*.
new: You know -ban/-ben and -on/-en/-ön from A1. No rule says which of the two a region takes: learn each name with its ending. *Erdélyben* and *a Vajdaságban* take -ban/-ben, but *a Felvidéken* and *Kárpátalján* take -on/-en/-ön, and for Burgenland both *az Őrvidéken* and *Burgenlandban* are used.
